concept.reason: Real mounted adult skeleton and auxiliary fossil photo plus primary anatomical analysis provide sufficient shape evidence.

scope: Whole adult reconstruction retaining pear-shaped torso, long neck and large grasping thumb; not a juvenile or skeletal display.

scientific_limits.en: Original living reconstruction. Seven metres is a taxon-level NHM estimate, not the measured total length of GPIT/RE/7288. Fossil mounts include reconstructed elements and poses; soft tissues and colour remain interpretative. Fabian is juvenile and used only as an auxiliary anatomical reference, not adult proportions.
scientific_limits.zh: 完整成体活体复原。7米为NHM属级估值，非GPIT/RE/7288实测全长。骨架装架含补配与姿态复原，软组织颜色不确定。Fabian是幼体，仅辅助解剖，不作为成体比例。

taxon: Plateosaurus trossingensis (older anatomical source uses P. engelhardti)

scale.basis: NHM taxon estimate; adult range independently described as 5-10 m by University of Bonn.

diagnostic_targets: Pear-shaped trunk with deeper broad pelvis/abdomen and narrowing chest, not uniform sauropod barrel.
Long gently curved neck with small elongate head, long tapering counterbalance tail.
Two robust weight-bearing hindlimbs; shorter arms held free with inward-facing palms, never flat weight-bearing pronated hands.
Five manual digits with clearly enlarged curved digit-I thumb claw; reduced outer digits, not five identical spikes.
Complete animal with readable negative spaces around elbows, neck and tail; original shape combination must survive comparison with Massospondylus and Mussaurus.
specimen_basis: Adult mounted GPIT/RE/7288 on right in Mallison2014 photo; published digital study supplements skull and hand with other named specimens, not claimed single untouched skeleton. Fabian juvenile auxiliary photo is visibly separate.
acceptance_checks: Side: long neck, pear-shaped trunk, smaller non-weight-bearing arms, horizontal balancing tail.
Front/top: visibly broad hips taper forward; both inward-facing grasping hands and enlarged thumb claws remain distinct.
Four standard views only; perspective may reuse preview bytes.
No automatic website-image equivalence unless actual renderer/config/hash contract matches.
